items.title: Solubility trends of Group II hydroxides and sulphates: (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Solubility trends of Group II hydroxides and sulphates:: a main subheading of 6.9.2 Lattice energy, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 132-133.

blocks.text: ΔH°sol lattice energy aur hydration enthalpy dono par depend karti hai.

items: Group II hydroxides: group mein neeche jaate hue cations ki charge density kam hoti hai, is liye hydration energy aur lattice energy dono kam hoti hain. Lekin Mg(OH)₂ se Ba(OH)₂ tak lattice energy Mg²⁺ se Ba²⁺ ki hydration energy se zyada tezi se kam hoti hai. Is liye yahan lattice energy ka asar dominant (ghalib) hai: ΔH°sol zyada exothermic hoti jati hai aur solubility barhti hai.

Group II sulphates: SO₄²⁻ ion OH⁻ se bohat bara hai, is liye MgSO₄ se BaSO₄ tak lattice energy kam ghatti hai, jab ke cation ki hydration energy zyada ghatti hai. Ab hydration energy ka asar dominant hai: ΔH°sol zyada endothermic hoti jati hai aur solubility MgSO₄ se BaSO₄ tak kam hoti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab sulphate ion ko 'SO₄²⁺' likhti hai; sahi SO₄²⁻ hai. Sulphates wale point ke aakhir mein kitab likhti hai 'more endothermic so solubility increase'; sahi yeh hai ke solubility kam hoti hai (kitab usi point mein pehle khud yahi kehti hai).

blocks.prompt: BaSO₄ MgSO₄ se kam kyun ghulta hai, jab ke Ba(OH)₂ Mg(OH)₂ se zyada ghulta hai?
blocks.explanation: Chhote OH⁻ ke saath group mein neeche lattice energy tezi se girti hai aur hydration kam girti hai, is liye ghulna aasan hota hai aur solubility barhti hai. Bare SO₄²⁻ ke saath lattice energy kam badalti hai, magar cations ki hydration energy tezi se girti hai, is liye solubility kam hoti hai.

items: Lattice energy: gaseous ions se ionic solid ka ek mole (NaCl –787 kJ mol⁻¹).
Bare ions: kam lattice energy; zyada charge: kahin zyada lattice energy (MgO –3923, LiF –1049 kJ mol⁻¹).
Group II: hydroxides neeche zyada ghulte hain (lattice energy dominant), sulphates kam (hydration energy dominant).
